title: context coverage gate — exemptions whitelist + config mirror
description: Machine-checkable documentation for scripts/context-coverage.exemptions.json (and, via /definitions/configMirror, the shape contract of scripts/context-coverage.config.json). The five kinds are the ONE exemption list (design X2-5/X6-8): prop-level kinds (bindable / passthrough / no-style / roadmap) exempt a vocabulary-hit prop from the Defaults existence + slot-coverage assertions ONLY; kind provider exempts a FILE from the legacy-helper bypass check ONLY (statically bounded to two reactive-declaration subtrees — provider-call argument subtrees and $derived initializer subtrees — see verify-context-coverage.mjs). A provider entry NEVER exempts Defaults existence, slot coverage, or resolve presence.

path.description: Repo-root-relative path (relative to the tree the gate runs over — the fixture roots carry their own copies). Must point at a real file; entries that never match a finding are stale and FAIL the gate (assertion 6).

kind.description: bindable: $bindable page-owned state toggle (class d). passthrough: prop forwarded verbatim to a child family's contract. no-style: vocabulary hit that is not a style prop. provider: inherit-then-provide container — legacy helpers legal ONLY inside provider-call argument subtrees or $derived initializer subtrees. roadmap: class-c prop awaiting its axis (appendix protocol).

prop.description: Required for every prop-level kind (all but provider). Must be a vocabulary word the file actually declares, else the entry is stale.

targetAxis.description: Required for roadmap entries only — the future axis this prop is registered against (e.g. elevation, shape).

reason.description: Non-empty justification; empty reasons FAIL the gate and the exemption does not apply (fail-closed).

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO date; past dates expire the entry (finding fires, exemption no longer applies).

configMirror.description: Shape contract of scripts/context-coverage.config.json. version 1 fields: vocabulary (EXACT enumeration — the pinned detection vocabulary), paintVariantUnion (the shared paint axis union), slotFactories (registered factories with genericity + arity), legacyHelpers + axisContextKeys (banned bypass channels), frozenAvailability (mirror of the variant grammar's frozen table §4 — bidirectional-equality reference for paintSlot values), pilotFamilies (the --scope=pilot subset, tasks 2.x).
